basic_info.description: Enjoy the ever-changing, always captivating views of the San Francisco Bay from this stunning property. This fully upgraded unit has combined what was a bedroom with the living room to offer a now spacious open living and dining area. Renovated by award winning Craig Steely Architecture, this space blends warm modern style with livability. The open layout is perfect for entertaining or everyday living. Views of iconic landmarks are visible from every room. There is an abundance of in-unit storage plus a storage unit. Doorman building. Amenities include a semi-private elevator foyer, BBQ/lounge area, community room and guest parking. Enjoy a short walk to the Fort Mason Farmer's Market and the restaurants and shops of Polk, Union and Chestnut Streets.
